name: input-group
description: A control with a prefix or suffix attached: a unit, a symbol, or a button sharing its border and height.

children.description: The control and its attachments, in visual order.

tokens.name: --yeti-border-width
tokens.description: The width the members overlap by.

a11y.notes: A prefix or suffix that carries meaning (a currency, a unit) must reach the control's accessible name or description: give the span an id and add it to the control's aria-describedby, or say it in the label. A button in the group is an ordinary button. Usually the group is the control slot of a field.
